name: dormant
trigger: Assistant closed; do not imply monitoring.

name: ready
trigger: Task surface is available for input.

name: input
trigger: Text composer receives input; not microphone listening.

name: processing
trigger: A clearly labeled prototype simulation is running, or actual processing has started.

name: result
trigger: Recommendation data is available; point to editable result.

name: clarify
trigger: A required user choice or unknown property needs clarification.

name: no-result
trigger: No suitable result was returned; offer correction.

name: error
trigger: A real or clearly simulated request failed; retry action available.

name: success
trigger: Save confirmation occurs only after actual local demo state changes.

name: return
trigger: User closes task or assistant; no emotional pressure to return.
